text: The system shall lock a user account for 15 minutes after 5 consecutive failed login attempts.
The system shall return search results within 2 seconds for 95% of queries when 500 users are connected.
The system shall encrypt all stored passwords using bcrypt with a cost factor of at least 12.
The administrator shall be able to export the monthly sales report as a PDF file.
The system shall store the customer record at the bank.
The system shall send the invoice to the customer and the accountant or the manager.
When the user submits the form, it shall be validated and saved by the system or the clerk.
Reports shall be generated after the data is updated.
The application shall be fast and user-friendly.
The system shall be secure against unauthorized access.
The system shall lock the account after several failed login attempts.
The system shall notify the user when the order status changes.
